{
  "action": "shell",
  "command": "PYTHONPATH=src:. python3 -c "
from cachetools.tagged import TaggedCache
from cachetools import Cache

# Debug: trace what happens during clear
c = TaggedCache(3)
c.put('a', 1, ['x'])
c.put('b', 2, ['y'])
print('before: _Cache__data =', c._Cache__data)
print('before: _LRUCache__order =', list(c._LRUCache__order))
print('before: _tags =', c._tags)
print('before: _expires =', c._expires)

# Manually trace Cache.clear
cache = c
cache._tags.clear()
cache._expires.clear()
print('After clearing tags/expires: _Cache__data =', cache._Cache__data)
print('After clearing tags/expires: _LRUCache__order =', list(cache._LRUCache__order))

# Now call Cache.clear
cache._Cache__data = {'a': 1, 'b': 2}
cache._LRUCache__order = list(cache._Cache__data)
cache._tags = {'x': {'a'}, 'y': {'b'}}
cache._expires = {'a': None, 'b': None}
print('Reset: _Cache__data =', cache._Cache__data)
print('Reset: _LRUCache__order =', list(cache._LRUCache__order))

# Now try Cache.clear
print('Calling Cache.clear...')
Cache.clear(cache)
print('After Cache.clear: _Cache__data =', cache._Cache__data)
print('After Cache.clear: _LRUCache__order =', list(cache._LRUCache__order))
print('After Cache.clear: len =', len(cache))
